content.short: Lista DAO combines BNB liquid staking, the lisUSD stablecoin and a vault-based lending market on BNB Chain.
content.description: Lista DAO is one of the bigger DeFi protocols on BNB Chain. Staking BNB through Lista gives you slisBNB, which earns rewards and still works as collateral. With BNB, ETH, slisBNB or wBETH as collateral, users can mint the lisUSD stablecoin through CDPs. Lista Lending adds a vault-based market where lenders and borrowers meet directly. The LISTA token governs all three, and a smaller deployment runs on Ethereum. It now calls itself an intelligence-powered liquidity network and has added bStock lending, where onchain stocks and ETFs can be used as collateral, along with borrowing against tokenized gold and bond yield products.
content.meta: BNB liquid staking with slisBNB, lisUSD CDP borrowing and vault lending in one protocol. Explore Lista DAO on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
